"OMUSUBI" Major Update Now Live!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2634560

On Saturday, April 19, the major update for the Japanese-style horror adventure game "OMUSUBI" has been released.

This update introduces a brand-new area, expanding the map and unlocking additional story content for players to enjoy.

With numerous new stills added, the visual immersion in each scene has also been greatly enhanced.

If you haven’t yet, now’s the perfect time to step into the twilight realm between this world and the next—the Hell's Edge.

notes.title: "OMUSUBI" now on sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049488/46488130c9956ef36a4cc29ce7cb040660503f3f.png[/img]
The Japanese-style horror adventure game, “OMUSUBI,” was released today.

This is an indie game that took one person 5 years (7000 hours!) to create.
The genre of the game is a multi-ending Japanese-style horror adventure.

The game immerses the player in the mysterious world of the underworld through beautiful pixel art that utilizes the charm of Japanese culture.
The game offers a checkered adventure between this world and the next.

↓Here is an image of the game's developer, KUSAKABE OSAMU, showing the 7,000 hours of production time.
